title: Finding Answers in Thought Matters: Revisiting Evaluation on Large Language Models with Reasoning

bias_targets.methodology: Analyzing how different handcrafted rule-based answer extraction algorithms systematically inflate or deflate the measured performance of reasoning models based on their output formatting rather than their actual reasoning capabilities.

Comparing automated evaluator models (e.g., GPTGrader, xVerify) against human annotations on an open-ended question-answering task to reveal their inherent bias toward systematically predicting 'correct' or 'incorrect' labels regardless of semantic equivalence.
